Enable.description: Whether to enable the sanitization service

ProductionOverride.description: Allow sanitization to run when the environment is Production. Use with extreme caution.

DryRun.description: When true, the built-in user and member sanitisers only log the records they would affect and make no changes. Also allowed to run in Production for a safe preview.

Replacement.description: Templates used by the default personal data replacer. {index} is replaced with a unique number per record.

EmailTemplate.description: Template for replacement email addresses, e.g. user{index}@example.com

NameTemplate.description: Template for replacement names, e.g. user{index}

UserNameTemplate.description: Template for replacement usernames, e.g. user{index}
